facts.fact: Egyptian Tax Authority head Rasha Abdel Aal said taxpayers have responded to the electronic systems and the mobile app and have already started creating accounts and submitting returns electronically.
Finance minister Ahmed Kouchouk said real estate transactions tax can be paid electronically by bank cards or direct-debit cards, with a final clearance issued online in five steps.

note: Homepage snapshot covers e-invoicing and e-receipts; its only filing links carry no statement of online filing or payment.
